length_limits.notes: A typical 8-page biological, clinical or social-sciences Article is about 4300 words with 5-6 display items; a 6-page physical-sciences Article about 2,500 words with 4. The Methods section does not typically exceed 3,000 words. The opening summary paragraph is up to 200 words.

figure_spec.notes: Standard figure sizes are 90 mm (single column) and 180 mm (double column); the full depth of the page is 170 mm. JPEGs are acceptable at initial submission and high-resolution files are required only on acceptance. Extended Data is capped at 10 display items.

reference_style.style: Numbered, superscript in the text; surname and initials, journal title italic and abbreviated, volume bold.

submission_steps: submit through the online system as a single Word or PDF file of up to 30 MB
figures may be placed in the text at initial submission
supply high-resolution figures only on acceptance

template.notes: There is no Nature-specific manuscript template; the journal is format-flexible at submission by design. The link is the generic Springer Nature LaTeX and Word package, downloadable without a login.
